events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Music & Art Fair began on this day in 1969 in Bethel, New York.

angles.name: Woodstock Vibe
angles.copy: It's 57 years since the mud, music, and peace of Woodstock. Which legendary performance defined it for you?

events.title: Remembering Elvis Presley
events.blurb: The King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, passed away on this day in 1977.

angles.name: The King's Legacy
angles.copy: 49 years since we lost the King. Elvis Presley's music still reigns supreme. What's your all-time favourite track?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The iconic Pretenders frontwoman Chrissie Hynde celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the incredible Chrissie Hynde! Her voice and attitude are timeless. What's your go-to Pretenders track?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman and rock 'n' roll icon Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: LG Birthday
angles.copy: Our Kid turns 54 today! Happy birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. What's your favourite Liam moment or lyric?

events.title: Global James Bond Day
events.blurb: Global James Bond Day marks the 1962 premiere of Dr. No, the very first film in the iconic 007 series.

angles.name: Favourite Bond
angles.copy: Happy Global James Bond Day! From Connery to Craig, who's your definitive 007 and what's the best Bond theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Legendary singer-songwriter John Lennon would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the visionary John Lennon. His music and message still resonate. What's your favourite Lennon track?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Celebrated comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty Towers, what's his most iconic moment for you?
